title: Provider Authentication & Dialect Framework

milestones.name: Provider Data Model
milestones.objective: Replace ProviderConfig with a proper Provider struct that carries auth method, dialect, credentials, and callback hooks
milestones.success: ProviderConfig renamed to Provider with AuthMethod, Dialect, Credentials fields; old endpoints.json format migrated

tasks.name: Provider struct with auth and dialect fields
tasks.what: Replace ProviderConfig with Provider struct. AuthMethod is an array of supported methods, user picks one via ActiveAuthMethod in credentials. Known providers have hardcoded URLs, custom providers need BaseURL from user.
tasks.why: Establish the data model for extensible provider authentication and API dialect support
acceptance: Provider has SupportedAuth []AuthMethod (array of what the provider supports)
ProviderCreds has ActiveAuthMethod (single chosen method) plus APIKey/OAuth
IsConfigured checks if the active method has valid credentials
NeedsURL returns true for custom providers, false for known ones
IsKnownProvider identifies built-in providers with hardcoded URLs
ChatURL/ModelsURL use hardcoded URLs for known providers, BaseURL for custom

tasks.name: Migrate EndpointsConfig and update all call sites
tasks.what: Update EndpointsConfig with new Provider struct. Default endpoints include vllm/ollama (need URL config) and openai (hardcoded URL, supports api_key + oauth). All call sites updated.
tasks.why: Ensure the entire codebase uses the new Provider model instead of the flat ProviderConfig
acceptance: DefaultEndpoints returns vllm and ollama with AuthNone and DialectOpenAICompatible
ResolveProvider finds by name, returns nil if not found
All call sites in stream.go, headless.go, models.go updated from ProviderConfig to Provider
No compile errors across entire codebase

milestones.name: Provider Interface
milestones.objective: Define a Provider interface with callback methods that each dialect implements -- avoids big switch statements, follows existing component callback pattern
milestones.success: Provider interface defined with PrepareRequest, has dialect-specific implementations, engine dispatches via interface

tasks.name: Define ProviderImpl interface and registry
tasks.what: Create chat/provider.go with ProviderImpl interface (PrepareRequest, GetAccessToken, NeedsAuth, IsExpired) and a registry map
tasks.why: Each dialect implements its own auth preparation -- no switch statement, extensible like component callbacks
acceptance: ProviderImpl interface has PrepareRequest, GetAccessToken, NeedsAuth, IsExpired, Refresh methods
Registry uses sync.RWMutex for thread safety
RegisterProvider and GetProvider work correctly
No existing code breaks -- old Engine path still compiles

tasks.name: Implement local/no-auth provider as default
tasks.what: Create a no-auth provider implementation that returns nil from PrepareRequest (passthrough for vllm/ollama), register it by default
tasks.why: Existing local providers (vllm, ollama) need to continue working with no auth, serving as the base case
acceptance: LocalProvider PrepareRequest is a no-op
NeedsAuth returns false
vllm and ollama registered in init
Existing Engine usage with local providers still works unchanged

tasks.name: Wire Engine to use ProviderImpl for auth
tasks.what: Update Engine to accept a ProviderImpl, call PrepareRequest before each HTTP call, fall back to old behavior if no provider impl found
tasks.why: Bridge the gap between the new provider interface and the existing Engine streaming logic
acceptance: Engine accepts ProviderImpl in NewEngine
PrepareRequest called before every outgoing HTTP request
Auth error returns StreamEvent with Error, does not panic
Backward compatible -- nil provider works as before (no auth header)
All call sites of NewEngine in stream.go and headless.go updated

tasks.name: Generic Sequence component for multi-step wizards
tasks.what: Create component/sequence.go — a tea.Model that chains multiple child components (Input, Picker, Question) with a shared context map
tasks.why: Reusable wizard abstraction for provider auth and future multi-step flows (tool questions, skill install). Components remain standalone and unchanged.
acceptance: Sequence implements tea.Model (Init, Update, View)
Steps are defined as SequenceStep with Key name and child Component
Shared context map stores results keyed by each step's Key
On step completion: result extracted, stored in context, advances to next step
On all steps done: calls OnDone with full context map
OnCancel callback supported
Child components remain unchanged — they don't know about Sequence
Works with existing Input, Picker, Question components

milestones.name: OpenAI OAuth (No-Browser)
milestones.objective: Implement OpenAI OAuth 2.0 PKCE flow without browser automation -- user copies URL, pastes authorization code back in TUI
milestones.success: User can authenticate with OpenAI subscription via paste-code flow, tokens auto-refresh, works on server and desktop
milestones.diagram:
sequenceDiagram
    participant U as User
    participant T as TUI
    participant O as OpenAI Auth Server
    participant A as OpenAI API

    T->>U: Display auth URL + PKCE challenge
    U->>O: Opens URL in browser, logs in
    O->>U: Redirects with ?code=XYZ
    U->>T: Pastes authorization code
    T->>O: Exchanges code + code_verifier for tokens
    O->>T: Returns access_token, refresh_token, expires_in
    T->>T: Stores credentials in endpoints.json
    T->>A: API call with Bearer token
    A->>T: Response
    Note over T: Auto-refresh when expires_at within 5min

tasks.name: OpenAI OAuth PKCE implementation
tasks.what: Create chat/openai_provider.go with full PKCE OAuth flow: code challenge generation, token exchange, auto-refresh, and PrepareRequest that injects Bearer token
tasks.why: Enable OpenAI subscription authentication -- the primary auth use case for cloud providers
acceptance: PKCE code verifier is 32 random bytes, base64url encoded
Code challenge is SHA256 of verifier, base64url encoded
StartOAuth returns full authorization URL with correct OpenAI client ID
FinishOAuth exchanges code for tokens and stores them
PrepareRequest injects Bearer token (OAuth or API key)
Refresh swaps expired OAuth token using refresh_token
Returns error when no credentials configured

tasks.name: OpenAI provider registration and credential persistence
tasks.what: Register openai and openai-codex providers, wire credential loading/saving from endpoints.json ProviderCreds into OpenAIProvider on init
tasks.why: Credentials survive across sessions -- user doesn't re-auth on every restart
acceptance: LoadProviderImpl returns OpenAIProvider for openai/openai-codex names
Existing OAuth credentials from endpoints.json are loaded into provider
New credentials can be marshaled back to endpoints.json
Local providers still return LocalProvider

milestones.name: TUI Auth Prompt
milestones.objective: Add a TUI prompt component that guides user through provider setup on first use -- displays auth URL, collects paste-back code, or collects API key directly
milestones.success: User sees guided prompt on first use of an auth-required provider, completes setup in TUI, credentials saved
milestones.diagram:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> DetectMissingCreds
    DetectMissingCreds --> ShowAuthOptions: user selects provider
    ShowAuthOptions --> EnterAPIKey: user chooses api_key
    ShowAuthOptions --> ShowOAuthURL: user chooses oauth
    EnterAPIKey --> ValidateKey: user pastes key
    ShowOAuthURL --> WaitForCode: user copies URL, opens browser
    WaitForCode --> ExchangeCode: user pastes auth code
    ValidateKey --> SaveCreds: key accepted
    ExchangeCode --> SaveCreds: tokens received
    SaveCreds --> [*]

tasks.name: Provider auth wizard using Sequence component
tasks.what: Build provider auth flow in app layer using Sequence component: URL entry → auth method picker → credential entry. No new component file needed.
tasks.why: Leverage generic Sequence component for clean multi-step auth wizard. Reuses existing Input, Picker, and Question components.
acceptance: Uses Sequence component to chain auth steps
Custom providers (vllm/ollama) prompt for BaseURL via Input step
Providers with multiple auth methods show Picker step
Providers with single auth method skip Picker, go straight to credential
API key mode uses Input step with masked display
OAuth mode shows URL via Question, then Input for code paste
OnDone saves credentials and re-scans model list
OnCancel returns to model picker without saving
No new component file — logic in app layer using existing components

tasks.name: Wire auth prompt into provider selection flow
tasks.what: Before sending message, check if provider is fully configured. If not, show config wizard. Also auto-refresh expired OAuth tokens before sending.
tasks.why: Integrate the auth prompt into the existing model/provider selection so user is guided through setup at the right moment
acceptance: sendMessage checks if provider IsConfigured before sending
Unconfigured provider triggers config wizard instead of sending
Expired OAuth tokens auto-refresh before sending
Failed refresh triggers config wizard for re-auth
Config cancel gracefully returns without sending

tasks.name: Wire model scanning through ProviderImpl auth
tasks.what: ScanModels returns sentinel entries for unconfigured providers (<not configured>) and expired creds (<auth expired>). Both trigger the universal config wizard.
tasks.why: Model scanner needs auth to fetch models from authenticated providers, and must surface auth-required providers as selectable placeholders in the picker
acceptance: Unconfigured providers return <not configured> sentinel
Providers with expired/invalid creds return <auth expired> sentinel
Both sentinel types have NeedsConfig flag set to true
Local providers with no auth need still show <not configured> if URL missing
ModelEntry has NeedsConfig flag (replaces NeedsAuth) for broader coverage

tasks.name: Picker shows auth-required placeholders and triggers auth prompt
tasks.what: Model picker shows <not configured> and <auth expired> sentinels. Selecting one opens the universal config wizard. On completion, saves provider and re-scans.
tasks.why: User needs to discover and authenticate providers through the model picker since that is the primary interaction point
acceptance: Picker displays <not configured> for providers missing URL or creds
Picker displays <auth expired> for providers with invalid creds
Selecting sentinel opens provider config wizard
Wizard completion saves provider and re-scans model list
Normal model selection unchanged for configured providers

milestones.name: Error Handling & Fallback
milestones.objective: Handle auth failures gracefully -- expired tokens trigger re-prompt, 401 errors trigger credential refresh or re-auth
milestones.success: Expired tokens auto-refresh before retry, 401 errors prompt for re-auth, unsupported providers return clear error
milestones.diagram:
flowchart LR
    A[HTTP Request] --> B{Status Code}
    B -->|200| C[Success]
    B -->|401| D{Has RefreshToken}
    D -->|Yes| E[Refresh Token]
    E --> F{Retry}
    F -->|200| C
    F -->|401| G[Show Re-auth Prompt]
    D -->|No| G
    B -->|403| H[Permission Error Message]
    B -->|Other| I[Standard Error]

tasks.name: 401 detection and auto-refresh with re-auth prompt
tasks.what: In Engine Stream, detect 401 response, attempt token refresh, retry once, then return error that triggers re-auth prompt
tasks.why: Expired tokens are common -- auto-refresh avoids bothering the user, re-auth prompt is the last resort
acceptance: 401 response triggers token refresh attempt before showing error
Successful refresh retries the request with new token
Failed refresh returns error message that triggers re-auth prompt
Providers without refresh capability return clear error

tasks.name: Unsupported provider error and placeholder error for non-openai dialects
tasks.what: When user configures a provider with a dialect that has no implementation yet (anthropic, gemini), return a clear error explaining it's not yet supported
tasks.why: Scope is OpenAI only for now -- other providers should fail gracefully with a helpful message, not a cryptic panic
acceptance: Anthropic dialect returns clear unsupported error from PrepareRequest
Gemini dialect returns clear unsupported error
OpenAI and local providers work normally
Error message guides user on what IS supported

problem: Current codebase has no credential support -- Engine fires bare HTTP requests with no auth header. Need scalable provider architecture supporting API keys and OAuth, with per-provider dialect implementations, starting with OpenAI.
goal: OpenAI OAuth (no-browser) and API key auth working; extensible provider interface for adding Gemini/Anthropic/Fireworks/OpenRouter; naming consistency across Provider/Endpoint/ModelEntry
